Jayashree Vaidhyanathan, Independent Director | industry = Power | products = Transmission Utility, Solar Generation | services = | revenue = | operating_income = | net_income = | assets = | equity = | num_employees = 700 {{cite web |url=https://www.owler.com/company/indigrid|title=Indigrid|access-date=23 April 2021}} | parent = | divisions = | subsidiaries = | website = {{URL|www.indigrid.co.in}} | footnotes = | intl = }} '''India Grid Trust (IndiGrid)''' is an Indian [[Power sector in India|power sector]] infrastructure investment trust (InvIT), sponsored by KKR & Sterlite Power (SPTL).{{Cite news|last=|first=|date=2021-09-29|title=IndiGrid unitholders approve KKR's induction as sponsor|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/energy/power/indigrid-unitholders-approve-kkrs-induction-as-sponsor/articleshow/78385480.cms|access-date=2021-04-20}} Established on 21 October 2016, the entity is registered with [[Securities and Exchange Board of India|SEBI]] pursuant to the InvIT regulations to own [[power transmission]] and [[Renewable resource|renewable]] assets. Harsh Shah is the [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] and Director of IndiGrid {{Cite web|title=Harsh Shah, India Grid Trust: Profile and Biography|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/20472659|access-date=2021-04-20|website=Bloomberg.com|language=en}} and Jyoti Kumar Agarwal is the [[Chief financial officer|CFO]].{{Cite web|last=|title=IndiGrid appoints former JSW CFO as finance chief - ETCFO|url=https://cfo.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/indigrid-appoints-former-jsw-cfo-as-finance-chief/78125051|access-date=2021-04-20|website=ETCFO.com|language=en}} As of March 2021, IndiGrid owns 14 operating projects consisting of 40 transmission lines with more than 7,570 ckms length and 11 substations with 13,550 MVA transformation capacity.{{Cite web|date=2021-03-28|title=Rs 4.6K-crore deal: IndiGrid seals power network buy in N-E|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/rs-4-6k-crore-deal-indigrid-seals-power-network-buy-in-n-e/2221961/|access-date=2021-04-20|website=The Financial Express|language=en-US}} IndiGrid is publicly listed on the Indian stock exchanges - [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]]. == History == In 2014, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) introduced Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) regulations to support growth of [[infrastructure]] sector in India.{{Cite web|title=SEBI {{!}} Guidelines for rights issue of units by an unlisted Infrastructure Investment Trust (InvIT)|url=https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/nov-2020/guidelines-for-rights-issue-of-units-by-an-unlisted-infrastructure-investment-trust-invit-_48082.html|access-date=2021-04-21|website=www.sebi.gov.in}} IndiGrid was established with Sterlite Power as its sponsor in October 2016, as per the SEBI InvITs Regulations.{{Cite web|title=Sterlite Power Grid Launches IndiGrid IPO|url=https://www.bloombergquint.com/markets/sterlite-power-grid-launches-indigrid-ipo|access-date=2021-04-21|website=BloombergQuint|date=10 May 2017 |language=en}}{{Cite web|title=India Grid Trust IPO Opens: Should You Invest?|url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/india-grid-trust-ipo-opens-should-you-invest-1694244|access-date=2021-04-21|website=NDTV.com|date=16 May 2017 }} In May 2017, IndiGrid opened its [[Initial public offering|initial public offer (IPO)]] to raise ₹2,250. It is the first power sector InvIT and the second InvIT to get listed on exchange after IRB InvIT Fund.{{Cite news|last=|first=|title=India Grid Trust: India Grid InvIT IPO kicks off; here's what brokerages say|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/india-grid-invit-ipo-kicks-off-heres-what-brokerages-say/articleshow/58713861.cms|access-date=2021-04-21}} In June 2017, IndiGrid got listed on BSE, NSE exchanges with two operational projects. Before the opening of IPO, IndiGrid had raised over Rs 1,012 [[crore]] from anchor investors such as Deutsche Global Infrastructure Fund, [[Credit Suisse]] ([[Singapore]]), Reliance Nippon Life Insurance Company, Copthall Mauritius Investment and Edelweiss Tokio Life Insurance Company.{{Cite web|title=India Grid Trust Garners Rs 1,012 Cr From Anchor Investors|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/india-grid-trust-garners-rs-1012-cr-from-anchor-investors-2281177.html|access-date=2021-04-21|website=Moneycontrol}}{{Cite In March 2021, IndiGrid raised equity capital of INR 1,284 crs by way of Rights Issue to maintain leverage headroom and fund future acquisitions. The [[rights issue]] price has been fixed at ₹110 per unit.{{Cite web|date=2021-03-24|title=IndiGrid Investment Managers board approves plan to raise ₹1,284 cr via rights|url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/indigrid-investment-managers-board-approves-plan-to-raise-1-284-cr-via-rights-11616586952024.html|access-date=2021-04-21|website=mint|language=en}}{{Cite news|last=|first=|title=IndiGrid's Rs 1,284 cr-rights issue will create more room for acquisitions: CEO|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/indigrids-rs-1284-cr-rights-issue-will-create-more-room-for-acquisitions-ceo/articleshow/81692407.cms|access-date=2021-04-21}} == Portfolio Assets == In June 2017, IndiGrid was listed on Indian Stock Exchanges with two Initial Portfolio Assets with AUM of INR 38 billion - Bhopal Dhule Transmission Company Limited and Jabalpur Transmission Company Limited, with a total network of 8 transmission lines of around 1,936 ckms and 2 substations of 6,000 mva capacity across 4 states.{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2017-06-06|title=India Grid Trust shares close 1.6% lower on stock market debut|url=https://www.livemint.com/Money/qHJbgoWxMToy9JxEiQKuCP/India-Grid-Trust-shares-trade-45-lower-in-stock-market-deb.html|access-date=2021-04-21|website=mint|language=en}} In February 2018, IndiGrid completed the acquisition of 3 transmission assets from its sponsor Sterlite Power Grid Ventures Ltd for Rs 1,410 crore. The assets were Purulia & Kharagpur Transmission Company Limited, RAPP Transmission Company Limited and Maheshwaram Transmission Limited.{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2018-02-20|title=India Grid Trust buys 3 transmission assets, picks up 46% stake in Patran|url=https://www.livemint.com/Industry/ten8sOpXzrBIyGCDpIQUKP/IndiGrid-acquires-3-transmission-assets-buys-Patran-Transmi.html|access-date=2021-04-21|website=mint|language=en}} In September 2018, IndiGrid completed the Rs 232-crore investment in Patran Transmission Company (PTCL). This was IndiGrid's first investment in a third-party asset.{{Cite news|last=|first=|date=2018-09-04|title=IndiGrid invests Rs 232 cr in Patran Transmission Company|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/indigrid-invests-rs-232-cr-in-patran-transmission-company-118090400665_1.html|access-date=2021-04-21}} In July 2019, IndiGrid completed the acquisition of two power transmission assets from Sterlite Power for an enterprise value of Rs 5,025 crore. These two assets are NRSS XXIX Transmission (NTL) and Odisha Generation Phase-II Transmission (OGPTL).{{Cite web|date=2019-07-09|title=IndiGrid completes acquisition of 2 transmission assets|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/indigrid-completes-acquisition-of-2-transmission-assets/1637400/|access-date=2021-04-21|website=The Financial Express|language=en-US}} In March 2020, IndiGrid completed the acquisition of its ninth transmission asset from Sterlite Power at a value of US$134 million or Rs 1,020 crore, with the acquisition of East-North Interconnection Ltd. from [[Anil Ambani]] group's [[Reliance Infrastructure]] Ltd. The enterprise value of the transmission asset was around Rs 900 crore (US$121.6 million). Taking this into consideration, an acquisition of 74% of shares should translate into a deal value of Rs 666 crore (US$90 million).{{Cite web|title=IndiGrid to buy 74% stake in Parbati Koldam Transmission|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/indigrid-to-buy-74-stake-in-parbati-koldam-transmission/article33205029.ece|access-date=2021-04-21|website=Hindu Businessline|date=29 November 2020 |language=en}}{{Cite news|last=|first=|date=2020-11-28|title=IndiGrid inks pact to acquire 74% stake in Parbati Koldam from Reliance Infra|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/indigrid-inks-pact-to-acquire-74-stake-in-parbati-koldam-from-reliance-infra-120112800761_1.html|access-date=2021-04-21}} In December 2020, IndiGrid Trust entered into an agreement to acquire 100% stake in FRV Andhra Pradesh Solar Farm-I Pvt. Ltd and FRV India Solar Park II Pvt. Ltd. From FRV Solar Holdings XI B.V.{{Cite web|title=IndiGrid acquires FRV's solar projects for $88m in first renewable buy|url=https://www.dealstreetasia.com/stories/indigrid-frv-solar-projects-220740/|access-date=2021-04-21|website=Deal Street Asia|language=en-US}} In March 2021, IndiGrid InvIT acquired NER-II Transmission Ltd from Sterlite Power at an enterprise value of Rs 4,625 crore. This is the largest single asset deal in the Indian Transmission sector. With this acquisition, IndiGrid's AUM (Asset Under Management) increased 34 per cent to Rs 20,000 crore.{{Cite web|date=2021-03-26|title=IndiGrid acquires NER-II Transmission for Rs 4,625 cr|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/indigrid-acquires-ner-ii-transmission-for-rs-4625-cr/2221196/|access-date=2021-04-21|website=The Financial Express|language=en-US}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links == * [https://www.indigrid.co.in/ India Grid Trust (IndiGrid)] [[Category:Electric power transmission system operators in India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 2016]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:KKR & Co. companies]]
extract:
India Grid Trust (IndiGrid) is an Indian power sector infrastructure investment trust (InvIT), sponsored by KKR & Sterlite Power (SPTL). Established on 21 October 2016, the entity is registered with SEBI pursuant to the InvIT regulations to own power transmission and renewable assets. Harsh Shah is the CEO and Director of IndiGrid  and Jyoti Kumar Agarwal is the CFO.
As of March 2021, IndiGrid owns 14 operating projects consisting of 40 transmission lines with more than 7,570 ckms length and 11 substations with 13,550 MVA transformation capacity. IndiGrid is publicly listed on the Indian stock exchanges - NSE and BSE.
